recommendations.recommendation: Give up pride and ego, and be humble before God and others.
recommendations.rationale: Ego blocks spiritual insight and divides a person from others.

recommendations.recommendation: Recognize that outward ritual without inner purity is empty.
recommendations.rationale: God is found in a sincere heart, not in outward show.
recommendations.argued_against: Empty ritual and hypocritical religious display.

recommendations.recommendation: Be truthful and compassionate toward all.
recommendations.rationale: Truth and compassion are the marks of a good person.
Greed and envy disturb the mind and bind it to suffering.

recommendations.recommendation: Know yourself honestly and examine your own faults.
recommendations.rationale: Self-knowledge is the beginning of wisdom.
Show without substance deceives others and oneself.

recommendations.recommendation: Keep company with the good and avoid the wicked.
recommendations.rationale: Company shapes character, so good companions help one grow.

recommendations.recommendation: Loosen attachment to wealth and possessions.
recommendations.rationale: Wealth passes away and cannot secure the soul.
